name: MPI Master-Slave Octree Volume Rendering
aliases: Parallel Volume Rendering with MPI and Octree Traversal
definition: A parallel volume rendering system using MPI to distribute rendering tasks across multiple slave processes. The master process spawns slaves, sends volume metadata and transfer function data, then distributes ray casting work. Slaves traverse an Octree (OTree) structure to find empty/non-empty blocks, compute ray segments intersecting non-empty blocks, and render those segments.
